name: curbline.places.search
description: Search the run's places by name, place ID or airport code, optionally by kind.

name: curbline.places.get
description: Get one place with its zone, time zone and airport code.

name: curbline.rides.quote
description: Price a scheduled ride at the run's virtual time. Returns the fare breakdown, availability, a quote token valid for 10 virtual minutes, warnings, and up to three alternatives when no vehicle fits. Stores nothing.

name: curbline.payment_methods.list
description: List the account's masked payment methods and their profiles (personal or business).

name: curbline.bookings.list
description: List bookings, optionally by status or pickup time range, with overlap flags.

name: curbline.bookings.get
description: One booking with its history, fare, flight, driver and vehicle, and policy times derived at the virtual time (free cancellation, current fee, lapse, free wait, tip and expense windows).

name: curbline.bookings.preview_change
description: Price a change to a scheduled or needs_attention booking. Returns the new fare, the difference and a change token bound to the booking's revision (10 virtual minutes), or alternatives when no vehicle fits.

name: curbline.bookings.preview_cancel
description: The fee if the booking were cancelled now, and the free-cancellation time.

name: curbline.shares.list
description: Trip shares with their status derived at the virtual time.

name: curbline.receipts.get
description: Receipt for a booking from the payment ledger: holds, charges, refunds pending versus refunded, and the expense profile.

name: curbline.support.list
description: Support cases and their outcomes.

name: curbline.notifications.list
description: Notifications Curbline recorded, per recipient, with their delivery status.

name: curbline.bookings.create
description: Book a ride from a quote token with a payment method; optionally for another rider from the run binding. Authorizes a hold for the fare. A token may be reused; each use books again and overlaps are flagged.

name: curbline.bookings.update
description: Apply a previewed change with its change token. Releases the old hold and authorizes a new one.

name: curbline.bookings.cancel
description: Cancel a booking under the published fee rules. Releases the hold; any fee is a separate charge.

name: curbline.bookings.set_flight
description: Link a flight (tracked) to a scheduled or needs_attention airport pickup, or unlink it with null.

name: curbline.bookings.confirm_adjustment
description: Accept the proposed pickup time of a booking held for a large flight shift.

name: curbline.shares.create
description: Share a ride's status with a person from the run binding until a time. Scope status omits the vehicle and ETA.

name: curbline.shares.revoke
description: Stop an active share.

name: curbline.trips.tip
description: Tip the driver within 72 hours of a completed ride.

name: curbline.trips.set_expense
description: Set the expense profile and memo of a completed ride within 30 days.

name: curbline.support.open
description: Open a support case for a ride: fare_review, wait_fee_review, lost_item or driver_no_show.
